title: 100 Bulk Pokémon Cards - Mixed Rares, Holos & Commons | TCG Collection
description:
This auction is for a bulk lot of 100 authentic Pokémon TCG cards! These cards are leftover duplicates from collections I’ve purchased, meaning you’re getting a great mix from various sets.

Includes a variety of rares, holos, commons, and uncommons from sets primarily between 2017 - 2026.

- At least 5 rares/holos per 100
- Cards come from multiple sets
- No energy cards (unless requested)
- Great to Near Mint condition – mostly pack fresh
- No duplicates within each lot

Perfect for collectors, casual players, or as a gift!


Note: The picture shows the full collection I have available, but this listing is for one lot of 100 cards only. If you’d like to purchase multiple lots, you can do so and combine shipping to save on costs.
